# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| deployment-package | `assets/deployment-package.md`, filled | Human with deploy rights on the platform | App, owner, plant sponsor, target, sourcing route, data read and written, dependencies, rollback owner and acceptance protocol are all stated |
| release-gate-table | Gate table in the deployment package | `dept-decision-rights`, Cyber Security (sign-off) | Protocol drafted; Cyber Security sign-off shown as requested or granted, by whom and when; Approval route named |
| acceptance-protocol | Drafted with `deploy-acceptance`, referenced from the package | `deploy-acceptance` | Protocol exists before release and is named in the package |
| open-questions-with-owners | List in the deployment package | OD lead | Each gap (for example lead time, deploy rights, Cyber Security requirements) has a named owner |
| hand-over-to-rollout | The package with the gate result | `deploy-handover` | A human has deployed and the hand-over is made |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| deployment-package | structure of `assets/deployment-package.md` | Human with deploy rights on the platform |
| release-gate-table | manual | Cyber Security (sign-off) |
| acceptance-protocol | manual | OD lead |
| open-questions-with-owners | manual | OD lead |
| hand-over-to-rollout | manual | OD lead |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `deploy-migration`, `funnel-requirements`, `invest-screen`, `dept-decision-rights`, `bc-build`, `bc-capital-request`
- **Next:** deploy-handover (step 3a6, rollout and adoption).: `deploy-handover`
- **Stops here when:** a package field is missing or the Cyber Security sign-off is not granted
- **Stops here when:** Then the package is invalid for release: list the gap with its owner and stop
- **Stops here when:** No deployment to a shared platform without the named human approval
